description_expanded: OverviewSteps to Sky Pool/Heated, Fitness Center and Tennis Courts, Private Beach-7 Minute Walk 4 FREE bikesThe Space Sandy Biscuits – Luxurious Rosemary Beach Retreat! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 3-Minute Walk to the Sky Pool – Heated for year-round relaxation Access to All 4 Rosemary Beach Community Pools – Exclusive resort-style amenities 4 Beach Cruiser Bikes Included – Ride to the beach or explore Rosemary Beach Quick Bike Ride to the Beach – Just minutes to the white sands & Gulf waters Spacious, Well-Stocked Kitchen – Features marble countertops & new gas stove 1st Floor Queen Guest Room – Perfect for easy accessibility & convenience 3-Minute Walk to Fitness Center & Tennis Courts – Stay active while on vacation Outdoor Shower with Hot Water – Connects directly to indoor shower for easy rinsing Located on a Quiet Street – Near the end of Wiggle Lane with minimal traffic Designated Parking for 2 Cars – Hassle-free & convenient High-Speed Wi-Fi & Smart HDTV – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to Sandy BiscuitsSandy Biscuits is a new renovated home in Rosemary Beach with all brand-new furnishings and extensive upgrades! The upgrades include brand new floors, marble counter tops, new paint and ship lap on the walls, Kohler plumbing fixtures, new gas stove, and all new furniture throughout the house! It will not disappoint!‘Sandy Biscuits’ was designed for your comfort and relaxation with the elegance of Rosemary Beach in mind. Throughout you will find beautiful stone and hardwood floors, elegant furnishings, and comfortable beds. Each porch is furnished so you can rest and enjoy the coastal breeze with just the right amount of shade.Follow the boardwalk for a 7-minute walk to the beach. There are 8 private access points to the beach for Rosemary residents & guests.The Master features a generous living space with a king size bed. The master bedroom has its own private bathroom featuring double sinks, a spacious 2-person shower and walk-in closet.Bedroom #2 offers a queen size bed and generous closet and drawer space. Bedroom #3 ('the bunkroom') comes with a XL twin over queen bunk bed with a twin trundle. Also, upstairs, our home features two bonus built-in bunks located on the 2nd floor landing. Bedroom #4 is located downstairs and offers a queen size bed along with a full bathroom located across the same hall. In all, you can comfortably sleep 12.For entertainment there are several ways to enjoy Sandy Biscuits and Rosemary Beach. You and your family will enjoy playing croquet or bocce ball on the lawn just out the front door in the shade of local foliage. Make yourself at home in the well-equipped kitchen and generous living space for communal gatherings featuring a smart HDTV plus cable and WiFi with plenty of seating for meals and enjoying time together.Conveniently located just north of Barrett Square, you’ll have no problem settling into the Rosemary pace enjoying a great cup of coffee at Amavida Coffee Shop and the variety of restaurants along Main St.The South Walton area offers a variety of activities from deep sea fishing, scuba trips, mountain biking, bay fishing, kayaking, windsurfing, kite surfing, nature walks, and much more. Just a short drive toward Panama City Beach, you'll have all the shopping you'll need at Pier Place - a large open-air mall featuring a large movie theater and many restaurant choices. We invite you to come enjoy "Sandy Biscuits" and all that Rosemary has to offer.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** Rosemary Beach HOA does not allow golf carts in this community***SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):Main Level* Guest Bedroom - Queen sized bed with private full bathroom2nd Level* Twin bunk bed in landing area* Guest Bedroom 2 - Queen sized bed, shared bathroom* Bunk Room - One bunk bed with XL Twin over a queen-sized bed with a twin trundle* Master Bedroom - King sized bed, private en suite bathroom, private balcony accessAREA ATTRACTIONS: Rosemary Beach Community OverviewBeachside destination with Award Winning ArchitectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis destinationsVoted one of America’s most romantic small towns by CNN (2015)Multiple parks & common “greens” featuring playgrounds, a splash pad, a butterfly park, and secret boardwalks with tranquil fountainsFitness Center offering massage and YogaBoutique shops and restaurants on-siteSugar white sands & Emerald waters – experience one of the world’s most beautiful beaches4 Resort PoolsBarbados Pool: gulf side, French West Indies style with vestibule fountainCoquina Pool: gulf side, with negative edge overflow meant for lounging and relaxingSky Pool: park side, indoor, heated year-round, with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: park side, “cabana style” with adjoining children’s pool and playground parkShow less
